newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Jan air passenger traffic up at main Irish airport.
newsitem.headline: Jan air passenger traffic up at main Irish airport.

text.p: Passenger traffic through Dublin airport rose by nine percent in January while Cork airport saw a 14 percent rise and Shannon reported an increase of one percent, Irish airports authority Aer Rianta said on Friday.

More than half a million passengers used Dublin airport in January with traffic to and from the UK rising by three percent, transatlantic traffic increasing by 27 percent and European traffic up 29 percent.
In Cork, throughput totalled 63,693 as European passenger numbers rose by 34 percent, transit traffic increased by 56 percent and traffic to the UK rose by 14 percent, Aer Rianta said in a statement.
A total of 83,530 passengers used Shannon airport, an increase of just one percent. Transit traffic there dropped by 18 percent because of a reduction of operations by Russian airline Aeroflot.
